candidates.title: Advantages of the mean absolute error (MAE) over the root mean square error (RMSE) in assessing average model performance
candidates.reason: Willmott and Matsuura's paper directly examines MAE as a measure of average model error, making it the best contextual match for the measured error table. It discusses an existing metric; it should not be credited with originally introducing MAE. Published in Climate Research, 30:79–82, DOI: 10.3354/cr030079.
